title: Ben Lauder blazing new single “The Problem’s You”
htmlContent:
Ben Lauder blazing new single “The Problem’s You”. Ben Lauder's latest single, "The Problem's You," is an energetic and thought-provoking song that uniquely combines hip-hop and pop elements. It pulls you into Lauder's mind, mixing clever self reflection with exciting beats and sounds.

Lauder showcases his confidence, rapping with a bold attitude and high energy. The catchy beats and fun electronic effects create a lively atmosphere. The bravado fades away, revealing Lauder's more honest and vulnerable side as he confronts his feelings and insecurities.

https://open.spotify.com/album/7kz9xDz336p1ijPmWMFy4I?si=3gCceyioR3mCrKel1AglkQ

The song wraps up with an explosive and chaotic outro that feels like an intense moment of self reflection. It's loud and messy, reflecting the overwhelming side of looking deep inside oneself. The production builds into a powerful wall of sound. Ben Lauder gives listeners an experience that challenges and connects with us on a deeper level. Ben Lauder blazing new single “The Problem’s You”
